notes.title: Update – The Ruins, UI Work, and a New Gameplay Mechanic
notes.notes:
We’re hard at work pushing Arms of God forward, and the progress has been super exciting. We’re working on several things simultaneously, and today we’d like to share the progress we’ve made over the past few weeks. A huge thank you to everyone who played the Alpha Demo and shared their feedback! We’ve carefully gone through it and will do our best to reflect your needs in the ongoing development.

Act One: The City Ruins and the Path to the Cathedral
The game will be divided into four acts, and today we’d like to show you a new concept art for the first one.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45217132/8d05ae5e6a7e98d9be75a30b101836ff3d14b7b1.jpg

The player's initial goal will be to make their way through the ruins of a city and reach the Cathedral, which will serve as the hub for meta-progression and the starting point for future challenges. Below, you’ll find an early screenshot from one of the levels.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45217132/792e70bd2a2a421c32d201bde1c87ea5f22d6c9f.png

UI Updates
From the beginning, we knew the UI in our game would be something we’d iterate on until launch, and this month was no different. We’ve improved the readability a bit and updated the visuals for the parchment and background elements.

Additionally, we’re working on expanding the Character Tab and its skill tree, but we’ll share more about that in the next update!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45217132/c6ecb9061bb79aea433e4d505c24a3c42cf8613b.gif

New Character
We’re also testing new abilities for upcoming heroes. The next character will have access to a Blink ability, which works similarly to the Dodge, but with greater movement range and more control. However, use it wisely, as it comes at the cost of a longer cooldown.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45217132/9f91f8757bae7aeb80d8f86396a49ac89d8ef287.gif

Camera Changes
One of the significant updates we made was adjusting the camera position. It’s now closer to a true isometric view, making it easier to control your surroundings from every angle.

New Gameplay Mechanic
We’re currently working on a new, key gameplay mechanic. For now, we don’t want to reveal too much, but the plan is for this mechanic to make its debut in the next closed beta tests (you’ll be able to sign up via our Discord here).

Thank you for your support and feedback! Stay tuned for more updates!

notes.title: Alpha Demo Closed Playtests + Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Hello Warriors!

The first closed playtests for Arms of God are currently underway, and we’re so excited and curious to hear your first impressions and feedback! These playtests will run until November 30th, so if you want to join, simply sign up using this link:

https://mailchi.mp/22cb29818f04/arms-of-god-playtests

What are we testing?
During these playtests, you’ll be playing the alpha demo. It features the first level of the game—10 full waves, ending with a boss fight. Throughout the game, you’ll encounter 10 unique enemies, each with their own nefarious way of attacking you. You’ll also have access to the shop, where you can upgrade weapons and combine them with upgrades. Plus, there's an option to combine one weapon with another!

Patch Notes 
(since the PGA Expo version, October 25-27, 2024)

Game Localization

 Game localized into Polish and Chinese.

Extensive UI Updates:

 Icon colors now change based on their type.
 Updated highlighting for selections.
 Adjusted button positions.
 Improved item combination visuals, clearly showing what is being combined.
 Enhanced navigation for both gamepad and keyboard.
 Numerous minor visual tweaks and adjustments.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45217132/a650257df6f69731da44620c7741aa5521c46f2d.png
Character Enhancements:

 Improved character responsiveness: faster acceleration, quicker dodges, and increased dodge range.
 Enhanced boss animations with additional effects and scale adjustments – the boss is now much larger!
 Better visibility of enemy projectiles.

New Visual Effects and Menu Updates:

 Added animations to the main game menu.
 New character and weapon selection screen.
 Added gamepad/keyboard icons for actions – the game now automatically switches inputs based on the device in use.
 Updated weapon effects, introducing a new type of damage: Holy Damage!

New Weapon Categories:

 Grenade Launcher – Fires explosive projectiles that arc into the center of enemy hordes. 
 Mine Launcher – Deploys mines that home in on the nearest enemies and explode on contact. 
 Heavenly Wrath – A projectile that instantly falls from the sky. 
 Laser Weapon – Slices through all enemies in its path in a fraction of a second.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45217132/48c60477a843dd6fdcd98760085dc20aed914989.png

Additional Weapon Enhancements:

 Melee weapons now generate additional shockwaves when upgrading the number of projectiles.

New Features:

 Added a game tutorial.
 Rebalanced and adjusted specific upgrades.
 New weapon firing sound effects.
 Numerous small fixes and quality-of-life improvements to enhance gameplay.


After the first few days of testing, the demo has been updated with the following fixes:


 Localization issues fixed
 ESC button now correctly exits the shop
 "Try again" option has been disabled
 You can no longer continue the game after completing wave 10 or dying


Thank you for the initial feedback on our Discord!

What’s missing in the alpha demo but planned for EA?

📖Story mode with ~50 unique levels
📈 Metaprogression
🏁 Quest tab
🤺 Character tab where you can level up the active skill tree for your chosen hero
🇯🇵 Localization for additional languages (Japanese, French, German, Portuguese, Spanish)
🔥 and more!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45217132/9736c751c6d53040e0ec56be081e347ccead4dcd.png

What’s next?
The alpha demo is just a preview. The full, “proper” demo is planned for release in April 2025, and it will definitely be preceded by another round of playtests. Join our Discord so you don’t miss any important updates on the development of Arms of God!

Thanks again for your support and feedback!
